verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's first-party docs describe a dedicated Scheduled flag changes feature for defining targeting-rule changes at future points in time, including scheduling the incremental steps of a release up to 100%. The targeting docs add that expiration dates can be set on flag targeting. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling, and documentation depth on time-specification details and on scheduling programmatically via API/CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Scheduling flag changes lets you define and schedule changes to your flag's targeting rules for future points in time.
You can create a progressive delivery strategy by scheduling the incremental steps to release your feature to 100% of your user base.
You can even set expiration dates for flag targeting if you know you only want customers to receive a flag for a specific period of time.
